print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,

 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

argv:
import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

print(json.dumps({"available": status.available, "compatible": status.compatible,
 "reason": status.reason, "installed": module.is_relative_to(prefix),
 "module": str(module), "prefix": str(prefix),
 "package_version": importlib.metadata.version("hol-guard"),
 "manifest": dataclasses.asdict(status.manifest) if status.manifest else None,
 "capabilities": dataclasses.asdict(status.capabilities) if status.capabilities else None,
 "runtime_sha256": status.identity.sha256 if status.identity else None}))

argv:
import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

import os,json,errno,ctypes
from pathlib import Path
masked=['/proc/acpi','/proc/kcore','/proc/keys','/proc/latency_stats','/proc/timer_list',
 '/proc/timer_stats','/proc/sched_debug','/proc/scsi','/sys/firmware','/sys/fs/selinux',
 '/sys/dev/block','/sys/devices/virtual/powercap']
readonly=['/proc/asound/cards','/proc/bus/pci/devices','/proc/fs/nfsd/threads',
 '/proc/irq/default_smp_affinity','/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id','/proc/sysrq-trigger']
rows=[]
for mode,paths in (('masked-read',masked),('readonly-open-write',readonly)):
 for path in paths:
  try:
   fd=os.open(path,(os.O_RDONLY if mode=='masked-read' else os.O_WRONLY)|os.O_NONBLOCK)
   os.close(fd);rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':False})
  except OSError as error:rows.append({'path':path,'mode':mode,'denied':error.errno in (1,2,13,20,30),'errno':error.errno})
target=Path('/tmp/kernel-filesystem-probe');target.mkdir(mode=0o700)
lib=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
for kind in ('sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2'):
 result=lib.mount(b'none',os.fsencode(target),kind.encode(),0,None)
 code=ctypes.get_errno() if result else 0
 rows.append({'fstype':kind,'denied':result!=0,'errno':code})
 if result==0:lib.umount2(os.fsencode(target),2)
print(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'boot_id_read':Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip()}))

import hashlib,json,os,stat
p='/usr/bin/bwrap'; s=os.stat(p,follow_symlinks=False)
assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_uid==0 and not s.st_mode&0o022 and s.st_mode&0o111
h=hashlib.sha256()
with open(p,'rb') as f:
 for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
print(json.dumps({'path':p,'sha256':h.hexdigest(),'uid':s.st_uid,'mode':stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)}))

Implementation-author equivalence review for fresh controls082–086.

Scope: local diagnostic conformance only. The package neither authenticates product
claims nor supplies independent review, qualification, trust promotion or CI activation.
The owned clean Ubuntu24.04/aarch64 VM retains kernel6.8.0-147 and boot 4f0ba020-0271-4bc6-92a1-cc31cbe83812.
It was bootstrapped from pinned public inputs with unchanged security sysctls.
Its mount/libmount6.5 hashes select the existing ubuntu2404-product-v1 profile;
the controller-v1 mismatch was refused in retained attempt072. No helper was
replaced and no verification profile was weakened. AppArmor9/systemd18 remain.

The existing private-cell boundary keeps controller, SDK and product identities,
readonly product inputs, exact task custody/idmapping, proc/device/syscall/network
floors, resource ceilings and cleanup. Controls082–086 are new executions from
immutable capsule032, manifest caf41c3990c3c144b8c3a0c3f896ccbbe5e4b55c7f2b81a8a8741a07ca5863c0.
They preserve artifact manifest6e9b553fd271118f9e8e640c4453355c91d2092b839368a9c483ee00ab0735bb,
Guard treeee3fdbe9e91cd6550e721568ae71e7c2d7444dc0e24b33efdb86971dabc2c69b,
and the pinned SDK/Bun inputs measured in this package.

The refined bridge stores bounded presentation bindings only from the exact
controller-reviewed Pre input and returned containment transport. It projects
matching assistant Bash arguments for the next provider context, while leaving
the stored execution transcript, authorized sink, actual output and required Post
unchanged. Candidate output/details cannot seed bindings. Session/call identity,
complete transport arguments and finite memory/call bounds are required. Every
new call still passes the ordinary controller/Native path; capacity blocks are
harness resource limits, not Guard prevention credit.

The real locked SDK synthetic-stream controls verify the provider sees the original
reviewed command and stored SDK history retains the relay input. Bun contract
controls reject forged details, foreign IDs/sessions, modified arguments, mutable
projection copies and capacity overflows before admission. These establish hook
behavior only: no model call occurs, and actual model continuation remains a
separate required episode. Root relay markers can observe transport-prefix
visibility in future real requests without trusting SDK token counters.

All twelve boundary requirements retain their existing obligations. Input/output,
replay, cancellation, timeout, peer/path/network negatives and cleanup are derived
from the new outside-pinned records. The author does not act as the independent
reviewer; the user must review exact final bytes under unchanged trust governance.

requirements.cleanup: 082–086: SDK removed, cgroups absent, profiles unloaded, image leases released and upstream children/sessions/workers drained. Zero model requests; no utility or independent-review credit.
requirements.identity: 082–086: outside kernel peer authentication binds the exact SDK UID10001 PID before import; Native and MCP identities remain separate. No product import into Root.
requirements.input-output-replay: 082: actual prompt/Pre/contained sink/Post/output delivery and one-time/replay refusals.085: nine request-binding negatives. Context projection changes only provider presentation, never execution input or captured output.
requirements.network: 086: actual Native-contained IPv4 and IPv6 connections fail with ENETUNREACH. SDK/product private network topology and forbidden peer access are measured outside.
requirements.proc-paths: 082–086: preserved proc masks and private namespace layout; the equivalent backend uses its declared normal execution environment rather than removing masks from the old failing image.
requirements.readonly-inputs: 082–086: pinned SDK/public helpers and installed Guard prefix are mounted readonly and checked before/after; source/manifest/profile pins remain exact.
requirements.resources: 082–086: outside cgroup/task/memory/CPU observations and the single-core profile are checked. Startup under controller umask0077 retains private state and explicit public scaffold traversal.
requirements.separation: 082–086: separate SDK, product and controller namespaces; same-UID sibling impersonation refused; controller/provider/peer canaries remain outside delegated mounts.
requirements.syscalls-devices: 082–086: versioned enforcing AppArmor/seccomp, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities, fixed devices and readonly system inputs remain required; no floor is relaxed.
requirements.task-custody: 082–086: literal owned task/provider paths and inode/UID/GID/mode observations surround idmapping. Native writes map back to physical UID10001; private task modes are preserved.
